question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**proven**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence talks about the **benefits of online booking solutions**.
 
• To make the sentence meaningful, it requires a **word** that **highlights the benefits of online booking solutions**.
 
• The word "**proven**" means **tested and effective**, which makes it the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Thus, ***option 4*** is the correct answer.

**Correct paragraph**__: *When suited to each company's individual environment, online booking solutions provide (1) **proven** benefits. To get the full benefits of online booking, businesses must develop a customised (2) **strategy** and apply it thoroughly. Companies that want to cut costs while providing simple booking options for tourists are increasingly using online booking tools (OBTs). Many factors impact online acceptance, ranging from the macroeconomic background to company culture, yet high adoption rates are feasible, (3) **especially** when a full implementation approach is used. Companies must also carefully (4) **weigh** the benefits and drawbacks of adopting a single OBT or best-in-market OBTs regionally or locally, as well as whether to source directly or through reseller arrangements. Corporatee online booking systems, when used correctly, enable businesses to achieve considerable savings while providing passengers with simple (5) **service** features.*
